buildCommand: if [ -n "$CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY" ]; then npx convex deploy --cmd-url-env-var-name VITE_CONVEX_URL --cmd 'pnpm --filter openportfolio-browser build'; elif [ -n "$VITE_CONVEX_URL" ]; then pnpm --filter openportfolio-browser build; else echo 'Set CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY (or install the Convex integration) so the build can provision and reach a backend, or set VITE_CONVEX_URL to a deployment you already own. Building with neither ships a page that can only say the variable is missing.' >&2; exit 1; fi
